name: Jesus
line: The Gospels tell his life; the apostles proclaim him across the New Testament.
words: The way, the truth, and the life
memory: God has spoken by his Son

name: David
line: From the sheepfold to the throne, his name carries through the songs and promises of Scripture.
words: I come in the name of the LORD
Who am I, O Lord GOD?

name: Moses
line: From the water and the wilderness to the law, the prophets, and the song in Revelation.

name: Aaron
line: Moses’ brother and spokesman, called to serve at the altar with his sons.
memory: Called of God, as was Aaron

name: Abraham
line: Called to go, taught to trust, remembered wherever Scripture speaks of promise and faith.
words: Shall not the Judge do right?

name: Solomon
line: Wisdom, a house for the LORD, and a reign whose splendour is remembered alongside its failures.
words: Give thy servant an understanding heart
Will God indeed dwell on earth?

name: Joseph
line: Sold by his brothers, raised to responsibility in Egypt, and remembered for faith in a return.

name: Joshua
line: Moses’ servant leads Israel across the Jordan and calls the people to choose whom they will serve.
words: As for me and my house
moments: Be strong and of a good courage

name: Paul
line: The persecutor becomes a witness, carrying the gospel across cities, seas, and letters.
words: I have fought a good fight

name: Peter
line: From the shores of Galilee to Pentecost: confession, failure, restoration, and witness.
